authorization_gate: No staging, GPU smoke, training, or acceptance execution is authorized until a future user-approved plan and real-GPU smoke/adversarial acceptance.

base.staging_gate: new terminal staging run with verified qwen35-4b-base-staging-v1 manifest
base.staging_evidence: resolved exact revision, Hugging Face download metadata, required snapshot files, BF16 offline architecture/template smoke, and physical file hashes

rendering.source: same staged official processor/tokenizer revision only
rendering.messages: user and assistant only; no system message
rendering.method: apply_chat_template twice: user add_generation_prompt=true, then user+assistant add_generation_prompt=false
rendering.assistant_reasoning_content: explicit empty string so preserved teacher <think> tags remain verbatim answer content
rendering.prefix_requirement: prefix token IDs are strict prefix of full token IDs
rendering.masking: mask the official user generation prefix, including its empty <think>...</think> block; train only stripped response plus <|im_end|>
rendering.length: audit all 20000 at 16384 and fail rather than truncate/drop

lora.targets: 24 linear_attn x [in_proj_qkv,in_proj_z,in_proj_b,in_proj_a,out_proj] + 8 self_attn x [q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj] + 32 mlp x [gate_proj,up_proj,down_proj]
lora.frozen: vision tower, embeddings, tied lm head; only LoRA parameters trainable

recipe.objective: sum per-example mean losses without accumulation division
recipe.order: same-seed load shuffle followed by fresh same-seed epoch shuffle
recipe.checkpoints: every 512 samples, latest two retained, atomic evidence/resume into a disjoint run; final group has 32 examples
